jobs.description:
Field Marketing Manager | Precision Semiconductor Metrology
Abingdon, UK, with up to 30 percent travel

Reward and Benefits

  • £69,000 - £80,000 (depending on experience)]
  • A generous annual bonus, death in service and private health care benefits BUPA, EMI Share scheme (UK).

If you are a Field Marketing Manager who enjoys connecting advanced technology with the people who need it, why not join us in Abingdon, Oxfordshire, and own the regional go-to-market programmes for advanced semiconductor metrology systems.

About Infinitesima
Infinitesima is a UK-based pioneer in advanced metrology solutions for the semiconductor industry. Our patented Rapid Probe Microscope (RPM) technology combines the 3D surface detection of atomic force microscopy with high-speed laser actuation and interferometry, delivering sub-nanometre measurements at in-line production throughput. Our Metron3D 300 mm in-line wafer metrology system brings this capability into high-volume manufacturing, addressing process control needs for next-generation devices that optical and electron-beam techniques cannot meet. Metron3D is in use at leading semiconductor manufacturers, and we are growing our team as demand for in-line 3D process control accelerates.

jobs.title: Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Kurz und knapp

Suchst du eine Führungsrolle, in der deine positive Energie und dein Teamgeist den Unterschied machen?

Bei Picnic suchen wir nicht nur jemanden, der Prozesse steuert, sondern eine Führungskraft, die ihr Team inspiriert und jeden Tag zu einem Erfolgserlebnis macht. Als Teamleiter Logistik (m/w/d) bist du das Herzstück des täglichen Betriebs in unserem Fulfillment Center (FC) in Viernheim. Du coachst, motivierst und unterstützt dein Team aus Shoppers, stellst sicher, dass sie sich wohlfühlen und gemeinsam Großes leisten. Im engen Austausch mit anderen Teamleitungen und der Schichtleitung sorgst du dafür, dass wir als großes Team unsere täglichen Ziele erreichen.


Das erwartet dich 

  • Teamleitung: Leite, motiviere und inspiriere täglich ein Team aus 20+ Shoppers. Du bist ihre erste Ansprechperson, hast stets ein offenes Ohr und förderst ihre Entwicklung.

  • Tagesgeschäft: Stelle sicher, dass alle Einkäufe pünktlich, siche

jobs.description:
About Electra

Air travel is about to become something more: more direct, more accessible, and more connected to the places where people live, work and want to be. Every day in the U.S., people make 35 million trips of 50–500 miles, stuck in traffic or routed through crowded hubs. Chances are, you've been one of them. At Electra, we're changing that with the EL9, a nine-passenger, hybrid-electric aircraft that takes off and lands in just 150 feet. Our Ultra Short technology opens up thousands of new places to fly, beyond conventional runways, congested airports and long drives. We're backed by Lockheed Martin, Honeywell and Safran. Operators worldwide have signed intent-to-purchase agreements for the first 2,200 aircraft we produce, and we're moving toward first test flights in 2027.

Getting a new kind of aircraft airborne takes more than ambition. It takes our kind of bold: people who think big while working in the real world. Who move ideas into action and collaborate without silos. Who put people first and make room at the table for everyone. Who challenge one another without diminishing one another.

jobs.title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
jobs.description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses

jobs.title: Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d)
jobs.description: About Recare As one of the leading German HealthTech companies, we are reshaping discharge management: technology-driven, patient-centered and free from bureaucracy. In addition to our market-leading SaaS platform, we develop AI solutions that radically simplify processes in hospitals and for aftercare providers, relieve healthcare professionals and refocus attention on patients. Today, we already connect two-thirds of all German hospitals with thousands of rehabilitation clinics, nursing and homecare providers. With around 100 employees, we continue to grow, and we’re looking for people with character who want to help us improve the healthcare system. What you’ll do as our Tech Lead (Medical Coding Agents) (m/w/d): German hospitals are paid a fixed amount per case, based on the codes assigned to it. Insurers dispute a share of the bills through an external medical audit, and the hospital can appeal when the audit cuts a bill. Recare is building medical coding agents to rebuild this chain: they read the case file, propose codes, assess audit findings and draft appeals. A subject matter expert reviews every result. You’ll lead the technical development of this product. The role is about 80% hands-on building and 20% leading, and it grows with the platform into areas beyond billing.
